page.title: Word packs
page.description: Create and edit the word packs you practice with. Export a list as CSV to import it in another browser or account.
page.notFound: The word list you tried to open could not be found. It may have been deleted.
page.exportFailed: Could not export “{name}”. Please try again.

manager.heading: Saved packs
manager.limitTitle: You can save up to {max} lists
manager.full: You can save up to {max} word lists. Delete lists you no longer use to create new ones.
manager.search: Search by pack name, list name, category, tag or word
manager.noMatch: No packs match “{query}”. Searches pack names, list names, categories, tags and words.
manager.csvNote: CSV export saves the words, what to type, and notes (practice history is not included). Use it with “Import CSV/TSV” on the create and edit screens.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.withRecords: This deletes the word list and all of its practice history.
delete.records: {count, plural, one {# practice record} other {# practice records}} (last: {day})
delete.exportHint: You can keep the words by exporting them as CSV (practice history is not included).
delete.packDescription: This also deletes {lists, plural, one {# list} other {# lists}} and {records, plural, one {# practice record} other {# practice records}}.
delete.lastInPack: The pack “{name}” will be deleted too.
delete.shareEnds: Its share link will stop working too.

empty.title: No word lists yet
empty.description: Add the words you want to practice and the text to type as the answer. You can also import them from a CSV or TSV file.
empty.packDescription: No packs yet. Follow an official pack or create a new one.

row.practiced: {count, plural, one {Practiced # time} other {Practiced # times}} · Last: {day}

editor.description: Add the words shown while typing and the text to type as the answer.
editor.displayRequired: Enter a word to display, or delete this row (empty rows cannot be saved).
editor.inputBlank: The text to type is only spaces. Leave it empty to use the displayed word.
editor.name: Word list name
editor.nameHelp: Shown on the practice screen and in your word lists.
editor.added: Added {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}. Check them and press “Save”.
editor.loaded: Imported {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}. Check them and press “Save”.
editor.dragInstructions: Press Space to pick up a word, use the up and down arrow keys to move it, and press Space again to drop it. Press Escape to cancel.
editor.shortcutNext: Next word (adds a row after the last word)
editor.recount: The word count changes from {from, number} to {to, number}. Records practiced with {from, number} words ({records, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}) are kept, but no longer count toward your best records.
editor.discardDescription: If you leave now, your changes will be lost.
editor.categoryHelp: Choose one of the categories in use, or type to create one. Lists can be narrowed down by it.
editor.tagsHelp: Choose tags in use, or type to create them (up to {max}). Searches look at tags too.
editor.noLabels: None yet. Type to create one.
editor.packHelp: The pack this list belongs to. Choosing another pack moves the list there.
editor.levelsHelp: Used to choose among the lists of a pack on the practice screen, such as Beginner.

import.title: Import from CSV/TSV
import.description: The first row holds the column names. input and display are required; annotation is optional. Columns can be in any order.
import.fileLabel: Choose a CSV or TSV file
import.previewLabel: Preview of the words to import
import.more: and {count, plural, one {# more word} other {# more words}}
import.existing: What to do with the words already entered
import.appendHint: Adds {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} after the {existing} already entered.
import.replaceHint: The {existing, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} already entered will be removed.
import.limits: CSV / TSV · UTF-8 · up to 1 MiB · up to 1,000 words per list
import.loadedStatus: Loaded {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}.
import.add: Add {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}
import.replaceWith: Replace with {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}

legacy.title: Move data from an earlier version
legacy.description: Adds the word lists and records from v0.1.x still stored in this browser to {target}. The original data is kept, and moving the same data again does not create duplicates.
legacy.none: There is no data to move.
legacy.done: Data moved. The original data is still in this browser.
legacy.failed: Could not read the saved data. The original data has not been changed.

words.title: Browse words
words.description: Choose a word list to see all its words, with the text to type and its note.
words.filter: Filter by list name, category, or tag
words.pickerDescription: The words of the list you choose are shown in a table.

packEditor.createDescription: Enter the pack's details and its first word list. You can add more lists later.
packEditor.editDescription: Change the pack's details and the order of its lists.
packEditor.name: Pack name
packEditor.nameHelp: Shown in the pack list and when choosing a pack to practice.
packEditor.listsHelp: Drag the handle, or use the keyboard, to change the order.
packEditor.dragInstructions: Press Space to pick up a list, use the up and down arrow keys to move it, and press Space again to drop it. Press Escape to cancel.
packEditor.announceCancel: Reordering cancelled. {name} returned to its place.

catalog.title: Official packs
catalog.description: Ready-made packs. Follow one to use the official content as it is; it stays up to date. You cannot edit it, but you can duplicate it to make your own pack.
catalog.full: Cannot follow: you have reached the limit of {max} lists. Delete lists you no longer use.

share.title: Share “{name}”
share.description: Anyone with the link can see this pack’s name, description, lists and words, and add it to their own packs. Practice records are not included. The link shows the pack as it is when you create it; changing the pack later does not change it automatically.
share.sharing: Anyone with the link can see this pack and add it to their own packs. After you change the pack, use “Update share” to refresh what the link shows.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it.
share.updateHint: Editing the pack does not change the link automatically.

orphans.title: Shares without a pack
orphans.description: The pack behind these share links is gone. Anyone with a link can still see it. Stop sharing the ones you no longer need.

sharedPage.intro: This pack was shared with you. Add it to your packs to edit it and practice with it.
sharedPage.loadFailed: Couldn’t load this share. Try again in a moment.
sharedPage.addFailed: Couldn’t add the pack. Please try again.

follow.title: Unfollow “{name}”?
follow.description: Unfollow “{name}”. The records of this pack will be deleted too.
follow.notice: This is an official pack, so it cannot be edited. Duplicate it to edit it as your own pack.
